verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs show several AI features that draw on the user's email data inside the product. Instant Summaries appear atop every thread, and an AI assistant can read threads and search the entire email history. Ghostwriter suggests completions based on the user's previous emails, and one-click identification surfaces important emails and todos. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insight features (community evidence predates or ignores them).
